name: Anteats
subtitle: UCI Dining Menus & Study
promotional_text: See today's UCI dining board, campus hours, and a quiet library. Search Anteats or ZotEats.
description:
Anteats (also searched as ZotEats) is the unofficial UCI dining and campus food app. See what The Anteatery, Brandywine, and Oasis are serving, check campus spots, and find a quiet library.

EAT
• Live menus for The Anteatery and Brandywine. Oasis shows Menu not posted during weekday hours when UCI has not posted dishes yet, then a live board when one exists
• Stations follow the hall: Twisted Root first, then rotating stations, desserts, pizza, and burgers last
• Tap anywhere on a dish card for details. Diet chips stay on one scrolling line
• Calories, allergens, and dietary filters (Vegan, Vegetarian, Halal, Kosher, Gluten-Free)
• Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner stay on the meals UCI actually serves. Afternoon Snack when posted. Late Night on weekdays when posted
• Browse today and upcoming days
• Full nutrition on dishes (macros plus expandable label and ingredients)
• Build today's plate with a running calorie and protein tally
• Rate dishes with stars (tap the same star again to clear), write a short review others can read, and favorite what you want again

CAMPUS
• Hours and open/closed for Starbucks, Panda, Subway, Zot N Go, food courts, and more
• Large filter chips for Open now, Coffee, Food, and Markets
• Retail menus when venues publish them

STUDY
• Library occupancy floor by floor (live Waitz), with a quietest-right-now pick and today's LibCal hours

WIDGETS & MORE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen / StandBy widgets for halls, today's menu, favorites on the board, campus open count / next open, and quietest library
• Live Activity meal countdown on Dynamic Island
• Light and dark on a plain white or black canvas. No accounts. No ads. No tracking.

There is no Gym tab. Unofficial student project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UC Irvine. Data comes from public campus endpoints that may change.
whats_new: Favorites stay on the hall, meal, and day you picked. Oasis says Menu not posted when it is open without a board. Breakfast and Lunch keep their own weekend dishes. Late Night is the last meal, weekdays only.
review_notes:
No login or account is required. The app reads public endpoints (Anteater API dining, Dining Hub campus food, Waitz library occupancy, LibCal library hours) plus a public community ratings feed on GitHub. Preferences and My Plate stay on-device (UserDefaults / App Group). Anonymous dish ratings and short reviews are shared so other users can read them. Privacy Nutrition Label: Other User Content, not linked to identity, not used for tracking. PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is in the app and widget targets.

There is NO Gym tab in this build. ARC gym busyness was removed until live sensors exist. Reviewers should not expect a Gym tab or ARC crowdedness charts.

App name on the store is Anteats. Subtitle is UCI Dining Menus & Study.

Demo path for review:
1. Open the Eat tab. Three equal hall tiles (Anteatery, Brandywine, Oasis) with a large centered name and a short time status (until 11 AM in green when open). Optional: Filters chip + Clear when filters are on. Oasis may say Menu not posted during weekday hours. Stations: Twisted Root first, desserts, pizza, burgers last. Late Night is weekdays only.
2. Tap a dish card anywhere. Add to Plate is the sticky primary button at the bottom. Favorites heart is secondary. Stars: tap the same star again to clear. Optional short written review.
3. Open My Plate via the Plate chip (empty) or tally bar (filled).
4. Campus: large Open now / All / Coffee / Food / Markets chips. Tap any place for the menu sheet or an honest empty/error with Retry.
5. Settings (gear) -> Notifications master switch, then Advanced for per-type alerts. Data Sources lists each public feed.
6. Study: quietest library + today's hours (Langson + Science).
7. Optional: Home Screen widgets (Dining Halls, Today's Menu, Favorites Today, Campus Open Now, Quietest Library).

Privacy: Other User Content (anonymous dish reviews) in App Store Connect. Unofficial student project; not affiliated with UC Irvine.
